missing: A simple, tested recommendation for the common case (phone plus lantern or headlamp for a weekend): which specific power bank or small lantern to buy, with measured real-world capacity, cable and USB-C compatibility, and whether solar is worth it at all.
why: No major independent tester like RTINGS or Wirecutter appears. REI is a retailer, though its advice is substantive. The niche sources give consistent sizing but mostly focus on large power stations. Several are affiliate or brand sites, so no source gives tested picks for a phone-and-light setup.
